hypothesis: Per-action independently learned sparse public component overwrite/copy rules can generalize from selected training transitions to never-seen combinations of full public imagery, mission and direction when the action effect is invariant, while an equal-data exact-whole-public-state predictor abstains. This does not establish unique model advantage against an equally trained feature-factorized conventional control.
authority: All observations are source-only authored frames validated by unchanged R10/R18/MG19 public source admission; original Yggdrasil source sha 8a1bf9c961a1c9b66080885d4d48106836638b5e, blobs 3917d36ce9f86a2c1b998a0a2f93fb27674a9205, 531b4f258408eb38f38794f03a192aacdad42315, 3db67b40d8d59fdfb41f89185b65d2f16e1d8aab. Not Farama, MiniGrid or original native model execution.

input_rights.public: full image 7x7x3, original mission, original heading 0..3; all values admissible under same original source validator
input_rights.fit: only before/selected-action/returned-after for actual selected evidence
input_rights.excluded: world-name, task/seed ID, hidden state, geometry oracle, reward/goal feedback, nonselected action returns, frozen CHECK labels

mechanism.family: bounded per-action local feature-effect rule state; independent 441 image components plus heading and mission; no transformer, token model, R7 8-bit casting or exact-whole-state lookup
mechanism.fit: for each action retain latest at most 128 selected before/action/after records, at most 896 total; update only after matching selected feedback; duplicate/mismatched or mission-changing feedback rejected
mechanism.predict: require >=4 selected records for action; infer each scalar feature copy when all observed next values equal original before and at least two distinct before values, or when before matches sole seen value; infer overwrite only when every observed after is the same constant and at least two distinct before values were observed and at least one change occurred; else abstain entire action prediction. Reject contradictions instead of guessing.
mechanism.forecast: compose 1..5 selected original actions only when every intermediate frame is supported by inference and source-admitted
mechanism.restore: bounded exact canonical JSON, externally trusted SHA256; verify evidence/counters/action/mission identities, reject pending action and corruption, fresh OS process restore
mechanism.learning_claim: Not unique causal inference: feature-factorized copy/overwrite is a conventional structured hypothesis. Genuine novel mechanism requires strong fitted recurrent/state-space/model-based controls and original-world heldout transfer separately.

missions: get to the green goal square
use original DoorKey mission constant from source
frozen_source_only_fixture.fit: For each action a in 0..6, selected t=0..11, source-public before includes all 7x7 cells with value from VALID_PIXELS[(pixel_row*7+col+t)%3], direction=t%4, mission=MISSIONS[t%3]. VALID_PIXELS are [1,0,0],[2,4,0],[4,1,2]. After: actions 0,1 preserve whole frame; actions 2..6 overwrite image[0][0] with [1,a%6,a] and preserve all other source-public components. Exactly 12 actual selected observations/action = 84 FIT observations/arm, no counterfactual feed.
frozen_source_only_fixture.check: 84 disjoint CHECK frames: same 3 missions x4 directions x7 original actions, VALID_PIXELS texture rotated with index and mission/direction, and image[6][6]=[3,0,1] never used in FIT. No CHECK is fed to any model. Must verify CHECK before frame != every FIT before frame for same action before scoring.
frozen_source_only_fixture.negative: one contradictory selected effect for action 2 at one previously supported public state after parity scoring must force ABSTAIN, not overwrite by cached effect; test mismatched selection and privileged observations rejected
frozen_source_only_fixture.controls: independently trained action-wise exact-public categorical count predictor on identical 84 FIT events; independently trained conventional feature-factorized identity/constant transition control with exactly same evidence and >=4 support. Both controls see no CHECK labels until evaluation. No artificial handicap.
frozen_source_only_fixture.decisions: Candidate must score 84/84 novel CHECK, exact count should abstain 84/84, conventional feature-factorized should score 84/84 (expected parity): report mechanistic transfer relative to count, NO unique advantage over strongest conventional. Any failure is FAIL, no retrospective retuning.
frozen_source_only_fixture.measurement: record per-arm fit/test CPU separately with process_time, checkpoint bytes and retained events; peak RSS only when independently observable and comparable. CPU in one test process not wall-time across system. Report all abstentions/incorrect/source violations.

negative_handling: Even PASS means engineering source-only generalization on contrived invariant rule, NOT original-world transfer, native integration, or scientific first-use. No acceptance, promotion, or autonomous worker activation.
noninterference: Additive existing FORGE DRAFT PR #1267 only; no protected ref mutation, no native Wingless/Yggdrasil edits, no original MiniGrid step, no FSA first-use, no controller/queue changes, no new PR.
